items.briefing:
A recent report highlights that AI data exposure is the second most common AI-related security incident affecting Australian and New Zealand organisations. This means staff should be cautious about what information they enter into AI tools — sensitive client details, internal documents, or personal data could be inadvertently shared or stored by these platforms.

**Practical tip:** Before using any AI tool for work tasks, check whether your organisation has an approved list of AI tools — and never paste sensitive or confidential information into an AI chatbot unless you know it is approved and secure.
